changelog: - **Group calls stop dying at five minutes — honest routing, and we count our own JaaS allowance** (#2011). The video host used to be picked by `inviteeCount === 1`: the JaaS tenant was reserved for pairs to protect a 25-monthly-active-participant free allowance nobody in the codebase could measure, so every project meeting, every bulk schedule and — via `inviteeCount: null` — every recurring series was routed *by construction* to public `meet.jit.si`, which hangs up an embedded call after about five minutes, with nothing warning anyone it was about to happen. Three changes. (1) `resolveMeetingLink()` replaces the four direct `generateMeetingLink()` calls and routes any room — 1:1, group, bulk, series — to the tenant while its projected head-count still fits the allowance; a spent allowance degrades a 1:1 to the public instance rather than failing to start. (2) `FreeRoomWarning` renders above the embedded call whenever the room is a `meet.jit.si` one, before anyone joins, in EN/TR/DE, naming the cutoff and the escape from it (the same room in a browser tab has no limit, and the button is in the warning). (3) The allowance is counted from data we own: `JaasMonthlyParticipant` is one row per (UTC month, participant) written from the existing `PARTICIPANT_JOINED` webhook — an HMAC of the participant id and nothing else, no names, no join to a `User` — surfaced on `/admin/integrations` as "N / 25 monthly active participants" via `GET /api/admin/integrations/jaas-usage`. The limit is `JAAS_MONTHLY_ACTIVE_LIMIT` (default 25, `0` = never use the tenant), not a literal in a component. Nothing here gates a call: video stays free-core, over-allowance is an announced degradation, and an unset tenant, a broken key or an unreadable database all resolve to a public room. `src/lib/meetingRoom.ts`'s reasoning comment now describes the shipped rule instead of the retired one.

en: Group meetings and recurring calls now use the same video room as one-on-one calls, so a team call no longer gets cut off after a few minutes.
If a call does have to run on the free public room, the meeting panel says so before anyone joins — and offers to open the same room in a browser tab, where there is no time limit.
Admins can see this month's video usage on the integrations page: how many participants have joined a call, out of the monthly allowance. No names are stored.
tr: Grup toplantıları ve tekrarlayan görüşmeler artık birebir görüşmelerle aynı video odasını kullanıyor; ekip görüşmesi birkaç dakika sonra kesilmiyor.
Bir görüşme yine de ücretsiz herkese açık odada çalışmak zorunda kalırsa, görüşme paneli bunu kimse katılmadan önce söylüyor ve aynı odayı süre sınırı olmayan bir tarayıcı sekmesinde açmayı öneriyor.
Yöneticiler bu ayın video kullanımını entegrasyonlar sayfasında görebiliyor: aylık kotanın ne kadarına karşılık kaç katılımcı görüşmeye katıldı. Hiçbir isim saklanmıyor.
de: Gruppenbesprechungen und wiederkehrende Gespräche nutzen jetzt denselben Videoraum wie Einzelgespräche — ein Teamgespräch wird nicht mehr nach wenigen Minuten getrennt.
Muss ein Gespräch doch im freien öffentlichen Raum stattfinden, sagt das Besprechungsfenster das, bevor jemand beitritt, und bietet an, denselben Raum in einem Browser-Tab ohne Zeitlimit zu öffnen.

Administratorinnen sehen die Videonutzung des Monats auf der Integrationsseite: wie viele Teilnehmende an einem Gespräch teilgenommen haben, gemessen am monatlichen Kontingent. Es werden keine Namen gespeichert.
